interface.shortDescription: Interview, plan, build, review and ship on a shared record of work.
interface.longDescription: Multi-agent development on a shared record of work. An interview turns a dropped task into a goal and a plan you own; the lead breaks it into goals, builders and reviewers work them, and you contradict what is not done. Skills cover leading and planning the work, building with validation first, review, design, pull requests, retros, self-improvement, lore and setup. Works on the idle-tasks record of work or standalone.
